51 weeks = 51 × 7 days = 357 days.  
357 days + 1 day = 358 days.  
1796 is a leap year (divisible by 4, and 1796 is after 1752 so Gregorian rule applies).  
From 1795-02-25, add 358 days:  
Days remaining in 1795 after Feb 25:  
Feb: 3 (since 25th inclusive? Actually from 1795-02-25 to 1795-02-28 is 3 days: 26,27,28 → 3 days)  
Mar: 31, Apr: 30, May: 31, Jun: 30, Jul: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → sum = 306 days.  
Total from Feb 25 to Dec 31 = 3 + 306 = 309 days.  
358 − 309 = 49 days into 1796.  
Jan 1796: 31 days, remaining 49 − 31 = 18 days into Feb.  
Feb 18, 1796.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1796-02-18
